'''DarkStryder's Fortress''' was a massive citadel located on the [[Northern Continent]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. Constructed of organic technology, the tower was mainly comprised of a translucent material that moved rhythmically, giving the impression of breathing.

During [[DarkStryder]]'s alliance with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] technology was used to reinforce the structure, including [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]].
